from pathlib import Path
targets = []

seen = set()
dups = set()
for t in targets:
    if t in seen:
        dups.add(t)
    seen.add(t)
Path("reports/compliance/wrk-188-worldenergydata-duplicate-targets.txt").write_text("\n".join(sorted(dups)))
raise SystemExit(1 if dups else 0)
